rationale: This is the same three ingredients as the archived RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED (industry-adjusted gross margin × R&D intensity × 3-period mean R&D-adjusted cash wedge) merely regrouped across the two RANK legs, which is a cosmetic re-parameterization rather than a new mechanism.

The myopia-plus-accrual-inflation story is coherent and the expression's sign convention correctly matches the negative expected sign, though it risks being driven mostly by the second leg, which the archive already shows to be the strong standalone predictor (RND_CASH_VERIFIED_EXPENSE_WEDGE, ls_talpha 4.13).

This is near-identical to the archived GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP and ACQUIRED_INTAN_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP — adding a small R&D term to the goodwill denominator and a 3-period smoothing of the same accrual leg — and it does nothing to address the archive's key diagnostic that those variants had strong alphas with essentially zero Fama-MacBeth slopes.

The organic-versus-acquired intangible contrast paired with persistent cash verification is economically sensible and not an exact archive duplicate, but xrd enters both legs with the same sign, so the composite may largely reload on plain R&D intensity rather than the intended organic/acquired distinction.

The expression is internally consistent with the stated negative sign and pairs two legs not previously combined, though the archive's change-on-change constructions (RND_RAMP_CASH_WEDGE_IMPROVE, INTAN_BUILD_CASH_VERIFIED) have been uniformly weak, so prior odds of success are modest.

This is INTAN_MOAT_ACCRUAL_TRAP with goodwill substituted for intangibles and the same depreciation-adjusted accrual leg already tested in GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP, and it inherits the archived version's construction flaw that IND_ADJ margins can be negative, so multiplying by gdwl/at makes the first leg non-monotone in the intended "acquired moat" concept.
